confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors combine general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur pricing with aggregator snapshots (Whereandwhen, Mylifeelsewhere, Getwherenext). Those snapshots are mostly undated and converted from ringgit, so they are rough. Accommodation anchors come from undated Momondo, Skyscanner, KAYAK, Hostelz and Trip.com snapshots that mix currencies and mostly predate July 2026. The Trip.com 3-star figure looked high relative to the other sources and was down-weighted. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are weakest; cocktail and wine use the local price relationship to beer (cocktail about 2.5x, wine glass about 2.1x), and direct knowledge of KL bar prices is limited. The FX observation was taken from RBA search summaries; the 16 October 2026 figure was not confirmed independently and the 15 October figure (0.6955) was reported by two separate search results.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used for the anchors. Estimates are based on Kuala Lumpur-specific aggregator data, cross-checked against general Southeast Asian capital pricing, with mid-range and budget tiers set to KL's relatively low restaurant and hostel costs.
